description: Twelve synthetic workers, two per corridor, for the Financial Coach (NF-FC-007). Every name and number is invented. Scripts are what the worker types, in order; expected_slots is what the interview must end with (CoachProfile); expected_score is the scoring rubric worked out with the fixed rates below, so it never depends on the live rate.
rates_note: Fixed illustrative rates, units of the home currency per one unit of the host currency. Not market rates.

Wala po akong ipon, zero po, 0 pesos.
May GCash lang po ako, wala akong bank account.
Opo, tama po lahat.
